entries.note: "The parcel's fee is charged, waiting to be sent." Minutes after the waybill, before any row shows Longteng handling the parcel.
"Sorted, Portland OR": the first row that shows Longteng handling the parcel, at its Portland depot.
"Sent, Portland OR": the pallet leaves the depot.

entries.wording: 送往机场仓库，等待飞行
entries.note: "Taken to the airport warehouse, waiting for the flight."
"Arrived at the port of entry, waiting for clearance": the clearance is still to come.

entries.wording: 清关完毕，等待国内快递派送
entries.note: "Cleared, waiting for the courier in China."

entries.wording: 清关完毕，正在派送，单号：…
entries.note: "Cleared, being sent on, number …": the parcel goes to a courier in China under the number the row ends with. The number varies.
